title: feat(spec)!: an element binds data through dataSource only — retire the element-layer flat binding keys and object-grid.defaultFilters (#11509)
body:
Fixes #11509

Clause-②: no (narrowing: the ten element-layer flat data-binding keys and `object-grid.defaultFilters` leave the accept set, and the component-props gate's `dataSource.object` waiver becomes a refusal)

ADR-0087 disposition, as the changeset's marker carries it: `registered element-flat-data-binding-retired, object-grid-default-filters-retired` (`.changeset/11509-element-flat-binding-retired.md`).

**Consumer pin rule (triage `6071460039`):** a consumer that pins both repositories moves its objectui pin past objectui#11880 no later than its objectstack pin moves past this retirement. The converted shape is one only objectui after objectui#11880 reads.

**Landing gate (claim `6072058120`, ruling sub-question 2):** `.objectui-sha` must cover objectui `5bc55c0c5a1e` (the merge of objectui PR #12010) before this lands. The pin bump is its own card, #22385 (claimed by the devx seat); this PR does not move `.objectui-sha`. At head `756fa0b33`, `.objectui-sha` is `f0268ad78485`, and REST compare `5bc55c0c5a1e...f0268ad78485` reads `ahead` by 8, `behind` by 0: the pin covers `5bc55c0c5a1e`. #22385 landed. This branch merged `origin/main` `3ca71b6e0` with `os-regen-merge.sh`, kept the re-measured repeater citation verbatim, and added the retirement on top.

**Held again (seat `6080485027`): the gate moves to #22476.** At that pin, Studio's page-block inspector still writes the repeater's flat `properties.object` and `properties.limit` (`block-config.ts:338`–`:345`), the keys this PR retires. The ruling's order is that the designer writes `dataSource` first. The fix is objectstack-ai/objectui#12056, and #22476 bumps the pin past it. This PR stays a held draft until `.objectui-sha` covers that fix; then it takes a merge round onto the then-current `main` and a contract review.

## What this does

Ruling `6051498447` (A-narrow, all four sub-questions at their recommendation), carried out as the claim states it:

1. **Tombstones.** `element:record_picker` `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit`, `element:number` `object` / `filter`, `element:repeater` `object` / `filter` / `sort` / `limit`, and `object-grid.defaultFilters` are `retiredKey()` tombstones in `packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`. Each is refused at its key with the prescription (use `dataSource.KEY` on the node; what to do where the binding already sets it, by that element's old rule), and its input type is `never`. The repeater's other spellings (`objectName`, `filters`, `where`, `orderBy`, `sortBy`, `top`, `pageSize`) were aliases of the flat keys and now point at the binding. The `object-*` block layer and the relationship-scoped blocks are unchanged.
2. **Conversions (step 18, both retired from the load path, both ordered at 35.5, before `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array` at 36).**
   - `element-flat-data-binding-to-data-source` follows each element's old rule: a key the binding lacks moves there; a key the binding already set is deleted where the binding always won (the picker, and `element:number`'s `object`); `element:number`'s flat filter is appended to the binding's (the two always AND-combined). It reports a TODO and leaves the key in three cases: a picker key beside a `dataSource.view` that sets no such key of its own, a repeater key the binding sets to a different value or beside a `view` (the repeater read neither until the console put its binding first, so what it applied depends on the console version), and an `element:number` filter pair that is not two rule arrays.
   - `object-grid-default-filters-removed` is the shape `defaultSort`'s retirement took. When `filter` is empty (absent, `null`, `[]` or `{}`), the rules move into it. When `filter` has content, the key is deleted. When `filter` is a value no lowering reads (a bare string), it reports a TODO rather than overwrite it.
   - A record-form value either entry moves reaches the record-form conversion at its new door. So the absorbed arms (the element flat `filter` and `defaultFilters` doors of `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array`) are dropped from that entry's reach.
3. **Lint.** In `packages/lint/src/validate-component-props.ts` the type-blind `suppliedByDataSource` waiver is gone. One of the three elements with no `dataSource.object` is the rule's existing `component-props-invalid` finding (warning tier, at `…dataSource.object`); this is not a new rule. The docs gate's twin waiver (`packages/spec/scripts/check-yaml-examples.ts`) turns with it.
4. **The repeater trap** is closed in this PR from both sides. A repeater bound only through `dataSource` is the clean shape: zero findings, and objectui reads it since objectui#11880. A repeater aimed by a flat `object` is refused twice: the tombstone at the key and the missing binding. Pinned in `validate-component-props.test.ts` and in the docs gate's self-test.
5. **Registry and generated outputs.** There are eleven `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows. There are two D3 entries (`element-flat-data-binding-retired`, `object-grid-default-filters-retired`), each with a step-18 rationale fragment. `authorable-surface/ui.json` (11 rows `[RETIRED]`) and `content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx` are regenerated by the repo's generators. The hand-edited `dropped-refinements.baseline.json` loses three rows whose only dropped refinement was a retired `filter`.

## Premises, verified on `origin/main` `bb4f5cc00` before the first edit

- P1 holds. The flat `object` keys were at `component.zod.ts:2602` (`element:number`), `:3015` (`element:record_picker`) and `:4134` (`element:repeater`). The repeater docblock's "NOT read at the pin" is at `:4117`.
- P2 holds. `suppliedByDataSource` (`validate-component-props.ts:169-185`) checks the issue path and `dataSource.object`, never the component type.
- P3 holds. `defaultFilters` is `z.array(ViewFilterRuleSchema)` (`:4563`), and the `defaultSort` precedent is `objectGridDefaultSortRemoved` (`conversions/registry.ts:9264`).
- P4 holds. There are zero authors of the eleven keys in `examples/**`, `skills/**` and the hand-written `content/docs/**`. The one element-layer author, the showcase picker (`page-variables.page.ts:59`), already writes `dataSource`. The spec, lint and metadata-protocol tests that authored the flat keys as fixtures are re-bound here, and the tree-scoped absence pin found two of them that grep had missed (`page.test.ts`, `i18n-resolver.test.ts`). `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` names `element:number` / `element:repeater` only as printable blocks and teaches no key, so no `skills/**` edit is needed and no hand-written docs page needed an edit.

## Decisions the reviewer should check

- **Three step-18 narrowings are absorbed, not one.** The ruling names `object-grid-default-filters-rule-array`. `element-number-filter-rule-array` and `element-record-picker-filter-rule-array` narrowed the two element flat `filter` keys this PR retires in the same unreleased major, and their acceptance criteria assert parses this PR refuses (`safeParse({ object, aggregate, filter })` succeeds). That is the same-major bookkeeping of the `spec-property-retirement` playbook (§0) and the measurement's "same-major bookkeeping against … its semantic entries". The record-form guidance they carried is the binding's own entry, `element-data-source-and-object-block-filter-rule-array`. The CLI's migrate-meta guidance pin drops the three absorbed ids from its `REWRITTEN` floor. The absorbing entries are not added there, because the list admits only entries rewritten off a tracker id and these two were born without one; the printed-block case holds them with the whole directory.
- **No new public export.** The three-element set lives privately in `component.zod.ts`. The conversion registry and the lint rule each keep a copy, and each copy is pinned against the tombstones by probing `ComponentPropsMap`. Publishing it would have widened a narrowing-only retirement.
- **Tombstones name `@objectstack/spec 17`, not 18.** `check:future-spec-major` (ADR-0087, amended 2026-09-13) refuses a tombstone that names the next major. The migrate sentence is `--from 17`, as with `defaultSort`.
- The `XParsed` aliases of the three element props stay, although their two shapes now coincide. Deleting a published type name would be an export removal of its own.

## Acceptance notes (not filed)

- `packages/lint/src/page-walk.ts:137` still resolves a component's object as `dataSource.object ?? properties.object ?? page.object` for the field-binding rules, and `content/docs/deployment/validating-metadata.mdx:157` describes that chain. After this PR the flat `object` on the three elements is refused by its tombstone, so the fallback only ever reads a refused key (and `element:metadata_viewer`'s metadata owner). This PR does not change it: the file is outside the claim. Carrier: none named; the next card that touches `page-walk.ts`.
- The docs gate judges only nodes that carry a `properties` mapping, so a bare `type: element:repeater` fence with neither `properties` nor `dataSource` is not reported there. The lint rule judges it. This is pre-existing dispatch behaviour.

## Tests and gates

All readings below are at head `d8e0996f4`: `c1d688804` (the CLI pin fix), then `origin/main` `35ef501e1` merged by `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`, with no conflict and no generated path to regenerate (`check:generated` 15/15 current). Taken on a shared box under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`.

- `@objectstack/cli` as Test Core runs it (`pnpm turbo run test test:repo --filter=@objectstack/cli`, `VITEST_MAX_WORKERS` from `vitest-worker-cap.mjs`): 373 files, 4964 passed, 2 skipped, both tiers. `test/migrate-meta-engine-guidance.test.ts`: 3 passed. At `756fa0b33` it read 1 failed / 2 passed, with "family lost element-number-filter-rule-array".
- `@objectstack/spec` unit tiers in full (`vitest run --project local --project repo`): 684 files, 19731 passed, 1 todo, 0 failed. `pnpm typecheck`: exit 0.
- (at `756fa0b33`; CI Test Core 1/6 to 6/6 is green at `d8e0996f4`) `@objectstack/lint` full (`vitest run`): 129 files, 5912 passed. `pnpm typecheck`: exit 0.
- (at `756fa0b33`; CI Test Core 1/6 to 6/6 is green at `d8e0996f4`) `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` `src/protocol.stored-migration.test.ts`: 40 passed. `pnpm typecheck`: exit 0.
- (at `756fa0b33`; CI Test Core 1/6 to 6/6 is green at `d8e0996f4`) `examples/app-showcase` `test/my-work-visibility.test.ts`: 7 passed. `pnpm typecheck`: exit 0.
- **Ablation of the lint refusal** (round 1; the guard is byte-unchanged since, so it was not re-run) (one-off, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, run from the committed head): the guard was mutated to `if (false && …)`, the mutation was proven on disk (anchor 1 → 0, blob `5c1af3370366` → `30bf2ab540c7`), and `validate-component-props.test.ts` went to 9 failed / 56 passed. Restored: the blob equals HEAD `5c1af3370366` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The lint subject is imported from source, so no build leg was involved.
- **The cross-package read** is a built `dist` (the lint test reads `@objectstack/spec/ui`). It is proven fresh by the pin that derives the three element types from `ComponentPropsMap`: against a pre-retirement `dist` that set is empty, and the pin is red.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands` derived 120 at this head (last round's 119 plus `check:cli-test-child-env`), and all 120 were run. `--ran`: "120 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED". All 120 exit 0, after a locked full build. `check:objectui-pin-citations`: 55 asserting citations match `f0268ad78`, and its 13 anchor content assertions are verified against objectui `f0268ad78`, fetched in isolation. `check:pm-dispatch-gates`: 2011 cases pass.
- Size: 4089 changed lines (+2669 / -1420, 41 files) by the dispatch-gates count at `d8e0996f4`. That is over the 3000-line human-merge threshold `main` set in #22490 (2026-10-09), so this PR lands by a human merge.
- CI at `d8e0996f4`: all 35 check runs completed, 33 success and 2 skipped (Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke opt-in), none red.
